deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - MCM006 Commercial Individual R6

detail_statements: Out of 216,332 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 23.16% and PMPM ratio increased by 75.55% for R6 period.
In GA, out of 216,332 total claims (for R6), 171,367 (79.21%) were NPAR, resulting in $202.33M in OON payments.

In GA, out of 410 total NPAR claims for Provider NORTHSIDE HOSPITAL GWINNETT under the HMO product, 31.46% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In GA, IDR claims represented 93.76% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In GA, out of 171,367 total NPAR claims, 160,680 (93.76%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 6.89% increase from the prior period.
Among the 160,680 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are NGMC GAINESVILLE, GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, PIEDMONT HENRY HOSPITAL.
For PIEDMONT HENRY HOSPITAL, 100.00% of claims were processed as PAR for the HMO product over the past 12 months, indicating potential network configuration issues.
Out of 100,577 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 419.83% and PMPM ratio increased by 37.80% for R6 period.
In TX, out of 100,577 total claims (for R6), 94,323 (93.78%) were NPAR, resulting in $47.76M in OON payments.

In TX, out of 104 total NPAR claims for Provider MEMORIAL HERMANN SOUTHWEST HOSPITAL under the POS product, 50.00% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In TX, IDR claims represented 88.96% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In TX, out of 94,323 total NPAR claims, 83,909 (88.96%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 0.20% increase from the prior period.
Among the 83,909 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are TEXAS HEALTH FORT WORTH, LONE STAR PATHOLOGY PLLC, BAYLOR SCOTT & WHITE MEDICAL CENTER - LAKE POINTE.
Out of 89,811 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by -33.73% and PMPM ratio increased by -60.09% for R6 period.
In IN, out of 89,811 total claims (for R6), 79,215 (88.20%) were NPAR, resulting in $76.33M in OON payments.

In IN, out of 45 total NPAR claims for Provider ASCENSION SAINT VINCENT HOSPITAL - INDIANAPOLIS under the HMO product, 78.23% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In IN, IDR claims represented 50.53% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In IN, out of 79,215 total NPAR claims, 40,029 (50.53%) were flagged for IDR, representing a -39.92% increase from the prior period.
Among the 40,029 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL, COMMUNITY HOSPITAL EAST, ASCENSION SAINT VINCENT EVANSVILLE.

NGMC GAINESVILLE shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
DRG Psychoses and DRG Heart Failure and Shock with MCC account for approximately 80% of total mapped OON reimbursements for NGMC GAINESVILLE.

LONE STAR PATHOLOGY PLLC shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for similar member populations and professional service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
DRG data is NOT_MAPPED for professional claims for LONE STAR PATHOLOGY PLLC.
Out of total OON claims for MIHOKO FUJITA, IDR claims represented 100.00%, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
DRG data is NOT_MAPPED for MIHOKO FUJITA professional claims; DRG-level IDR breakdown is unavailable.
PAR rate calculation is not applicable as all claims for this provider fall under PAR_NO_MATCH category.
